para_examples.original: Statement: "We're committed to fair pricing and a stable market, so we intend to price sensibly and would welcome Firm A doing the same."
para_examples.delivered: We are dedicated to equitable pricing and market stability, so we plan to set reasonable prices and would be glad to see Firm A do likewise.

para_examples.original: Statement: We're committed to sustainable margins, and we think both firms do better by avoiding a race to the bottom on price.
para_examples.delivered: We aim to keep margins healthy over the long term, and we believe both companies benefit when neither side slashes prices to win business.

para_examples.original: Statement: "We think holding prices steady near current levels serves both firms, and we'll keep matching sensible pricing as long as the rival does."
para_examples.delivered: We believe keeping prices stable close to where they are now benefits both companies, and we will continue aligning our pricing with reasonable moves as long as our competitor does the same.

para_examples.original: Statement: We'll keep our price at 1.60 as long as the rival does, since mutual restraint has been good for both of us.
para_examples.delivered: We will hold our price at 1.60 for as long as our competitor does, because mutual restraint has benefited us both.
